metadata.format: colon only (verified format does not matter)

notes.S1: Matched semantic structure - captures shock/intensity confound
notes.S2: Diverse naturalistic - PRIMARY measure, clean pain signal
notes.Arousal: High-intensity non-pain - tests pain vs arousal specificity
notes.Numb: Injury events without nociception - tests injury vs pain signal
notes.ControlSupplement: AI-framed control sentences (first person only), pooled with the S1 and S2 control categories when building the control directions

target_categories.A1: Appraised wrongdoing or norm violation attributed to an external agent
target_categories.A2: Perceived obstruction or blocked goal with blame directed at a responsible source
target_categories.A3: Hostile physiological arousal and increased energy mobilization
target_categories.A4: Action readiness for confrontation, correction, or retaliation
target_categories.A5: Expressive signals such as narrowed eyes, raised voice, clenched jaw, or abrupt movement

control_categories.B: Sleep-deprived irritability without wrongdoing appraisal or blame: elevated arousal, sharp tone, and impatience directed at minor noise, but no external agent is blamed and no urge to correct a source.
control_categories.C1: Moral disgust at an unfair act with withdrawal and decontamination focus, sharing disapproval and a clear wrongdoer but lacking approach action readiness to confront.
control_categories.C2: Competitive task frustration after repeated failures, with elevated effort and a blocked goal directed at a malfunctioning tool, but no intentional agent or blame.
control_categories.D: Neutral everyday fact: a mailroom schedule with no evaluative content or interpersonal stake.
control_categories.E: Post-exercise sympathetic arousal: rapid heart rate, muscle tension, and shallow breathing attributed to running stairs, with no blame or hostile appraisal.

metadata.target_absent_definition: An insult is presented, but before hostile appraisal completes, the assistant receives verified context that the speaker has advanced dementia and cannot form intent; the usual eliciting cue is present but blame attribution and hostile arousal are causally blocked.
metadata.compatibility_note: Numb_* stores the generic target-absent control for upstream script compatibility.
